test_title: PYST 07: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 08 Oct, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The way she elaborated on every detail with precision impressed everyone _____ the meeting.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The preposition "**at**" is the correct choice to use in this context, as it indicates the event or location where the action took place.
 
• The other options (off, above, into) do not fit in this context and would be grammatically incorrect.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Off:** This is incorrect, as it typically means to be away or separated from.
 
• **Above:** This is incorrect, as it indicates a higher position and does not work in this context.
 
• **Into:** This is incorrect, as it implies movement towards the inside of something, which does not fit the context.
